cli_translation_route.Cargo_command: charon cargo starts Cargo build with RUSTC_WRAPPER=driver, RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER fresh fingerprint, CHARON_USING_CARGO=1, and serialized CliOpts in CHARON_ARGS (main.rs:168-244).
cli_translation_route.start_from: Options document it as selected starting items plus reachable references subject to opacity; absent roots defaults to crate. `translate_crate::translate` resolves each StartFrom and enqueues the selected item before translating, then driver `run_charon` calls the post-translation passes and serializes (options.rs:65-102, 695-730; translate_crate.rs:966-1007; driver/main.rs:72-99). This is a compiler extraction root selection, not an input-LLBC postprocess entrypoint.
cli_translation_route.pass_order: Driver main calls `run_transformation_passes` after rustc translation succeeds and before `CrateData::new(ctx).serialize_to_files`; `transform/mod.rs` documents global passes, then body passes. Pass ordering source is copied and line-numbered in workspace-source-excerpts.txt.

native_ast_api.envelope: Public `export::CrateData` carries public `translated`, `charon_version`, and `has_errors`; `deserialize_from_file` and `serialize_to_file` are public. Its JSON reader disables serde_json recursion limit, uses serde_stacker, and restores HashCons state (export.rs:15-27, 75-169). A standalone downstream binary could therefore load, mutate public AST data, then round-trip the envelope; this is capability evidence only.
native_ast_api.ast: `TranslatedCrate` fields include public declaration tables, item names, and optional ordered declaration groups (ast/krate.rs:230-303).
native_ast_api.normal_pass_context: `TransformPass`, `TransformCtx::run_pass` and `run_transformation_passes` are public, but `TransformCtx` has no public constructor in inspected source; its construction is in the rustc translation module. External postprocessing through a new pass context is not shown by this API inventory.

custom_entrypoints.ui_test: The `charon ui-test` command compiles a Rust fixture with magic comments and compares/prints its LLBC output; it is not a saved-LLBC AST transformation harness. Cargo.toml and cli.rs/ui_test.rs copies are included.
custom_entrypoints.custom_binary: Cargo manifest contains no existing saved-LLBC transform binary. A downstream/new binary is possible in principle from the public library and CrateData APIs, but no such target was added or built.
